Transfer task approval emits one lesson notice; dispute acceptance only after actual director reversal. Outbox worker IN_APP via NotificationService, EMAIL via Resend stable key; persisted first-claim timestamp stops uncertain retries after23h, max attempts→FAILED. Safe public errors, no message body/email in delivery Outbox/Audit.59 own+408 affected+28 architecture/schema+1 worker=496 checks pass.125 operations,94models/221FK. Migration unapplied; no real emails or PostgreSQL acceptance.
